notes.title: Notice Regarding the Next Update
notes.notes: [p]Thank you for your continued support.[/p][p][/p][p][strike]The preparations for the next update are complete. However, due to Steam’s security protocols, the release on the official branch (default) may be delayed by up to [b]72 hours.[/b][/strike][/p][p][/p][p][strike]During this period, you can try the new version early via the beta branch.[/strike][/p][p][strike]To join the beta branch, go to your Library → Right-click the game → Properties → “Betas” tab, and select “[b]public_beta[/b].”For details on the update, please see the [b]“Update History”[/b] section in the Community Hub.[/strike][/p][p][/p][p][strike]We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your patience until the update is fully released.[/strike][/p][p][/p][p]The update has been applied to the official release, so you can now play from the official version.[/p][p]Thank you for continuing to support [b]“Clean Freak! Perfect Cook!”[/b][/p]
